rag.text:
Test: TC-3748 — Feature area - Risk - Add existing issue without a configured Scope as box Admin
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-83 Feature area - Risk
Labels: teamsource

Steps:
1. Navigate to Risk module of the boxName as box Admin
   Data: boxName: TC-3748 Feature area - Risk - Add existing issue without a configured Scope as box Admin
   Expected: Risk matrix load properly. No any tasks are visible
2. Click on Add risk button in the top left corner
   Expected: Dropdown is displayed with options: 
- Create new Jira issue
- Add existing task (greyed out, with info icon)
- Manage scope definition
3. Hover over Add existing task
   Expected: Tooltip "Manage scope definition first" appeared
4. Click on matrixCell
   Data: matrixCell: High/High
   Expected: Two options are available:
- Create new Jira issue
- Add existing task (greyed out, with information "Define the scope first")
5. Click on Define the scope first
   Expected: Scope definition window appeared
6. Add projectName to the Project field and click Save
   Data: projectName: TC-3748 Feature area - Risk - Add existing issue without a configured Scope as box Admin
   Expected: There is information: "2 tasks in the scope". 
Matrix is visible with info message: 

"Scope definition has been set up

Now you can organize your tasks in a neat and logical structure to view them clearly whenever you need to access them. Choose one of the predefined presets or create your custom task structure that will fit your scope" and two buttons:

* Configure task structure
* Don't show again
7. Click on Don't show again
   Expected: The message window no more visible
8. Click on Add risk button in the top left corner
   Expected: Dropdown is displayed with options: 
- Create new Jira issue
- Add existing task (active)
- Manage scope definition
9. Choose Add existing task
   Expected: Add existing task window is appeared.
10. Type in Task field failTaskName
   Data: failTaskName: qwerty
   Expected: The information: "No matches in the scope" appeared under search bar
11. Fill the fields with taskName, riskProbability, riskConsequence and click Add
   Data: taskName: Task A
riskProbability: Medium
riskConsequence: Medium
   Expected: Added task is visible on matrix grid in properly place
